save.shape: { "<contactKey(name)>": int 0..100 }, sparse: only NPCs whose value differs from base
save.normalize: save.js normalizeV2: fill(s, 'rep', isPlainObject, {}); drop keys that are not strings <= 40; clamp ints 0..100; drop fixed NPCs. v stays 2, key stays pixelpets.save.v2. Older builds keep the unknown field (normalizeV2 keeps unknown keys).
save.no_log: The +/- history is not saved. It is rebuilt from flags: every rep source in data (moral options, quest rows, joins) has a flag, so the compass can list what happened by checking which flags are set.
save.joins: S.repJoins = int (count of faction joins applied), additive, default 0. Lets a reload know the penalty for join n already ran.

join.when: story.side_pick_done turns true (first pick) and each switch via Rook (story.switch_via set, side changes)
join.effect: every NPC with personMet() true and faction == the side you did NOT join: rep -10 (clamped, fixed NPCs skipped)
join.later: NPCs met after the join start at base; the penalty is not back-dated (D178)

intensity.rule: effective = rep + mod. mod = +10 when the NPC faction equals your side, -10 when it is the other side, 0 for none/fixed. The tier for dialog uses effective, clamped 0..100. The compass shows the raw number and the tier of effective.
intensity.why: Same number, different feel: a Keeper at 55 is warm to a Keeper player and cool to a Glimmerwell one.

cond.lines: "reptier=warm" in an NPC lines map means the speaker
cond.impl: game.js cond(): add rep: and reptier: prefixes next to standing.

where: High Charity invite (story.hc_invite, Warden Ilse "Read the letter") - Ilse is fixed, so the tiers apply to who you show the letter to: Lizzy, Rook, Captain Lumen

Lizzy.close: High Charity! Read it twice, then read it to Buddy. He likes good news.
Lizzy.warm: High Charity wrote to YOU? That's huge. Buddy and I are thrilled.
Lizzy.neutral: High Charity. That's a big step. Be careful up there.
Lizzy.cool: Oh. A letter. That's nice. I have papers to grade.
Lizzy.hostile: I saw what you did to Mr. Gristle. Congratulations on the letter, I guess.

Rook.close: You got one too?! We're going together. No arguing.
Rook.warm: Huh. They picked you. Fine. They picked right.
Rook.neutral: A letter? Mine was probably lost in the mail.
Rook.cool: Great. Another reason for everyone to clap for you.
Rook.hostile: Keep your letter. I don't need High Charity.

Captain Lumen.close: Good. Bring that letter and your best manners. You've earned both.
Captain Lumen.warm: The Keepers will be glad to see you there.
Captain Lumen.neutral: Present it at the gate. They check the seal.
Captain Lumen.cool: Letters are easy to get. Keeping them is harder.
Captain Lumen.hostile: I will be watching what you do with that letter.

letter_quests.intensity_example: Captain Lumen at rep 55: Keeper player -> effective 65 (warm); Glimmerwell player -> effective 45 (neutral).

quest_moves: Each quest that changes rep lists it in data (moral options; plain quests may add a "rep" step). No hidden moves.

ranks.decision: NPC_RANKS (Vincent, Nov 2, 2026): every Keeper and Glimmerwell NPC shows rank, then name, wherever the name is shown
ranks.fields: rank: shown before given ("Master" + "Fen"). given: the bare name. duty: a job that is not a rank (KEEPER_RANKS D893), shown on the contact card. rankFlag: the D id asking whether this NPC is Keeper or Glimmerwell at all; shown as today. rankWhen: a named game condition (game.js RANK_WHEN) that must hold for the rank to show civilian: host or shop; a civilian never carries a rank
ranks.display: game.js shownName(): rank + ' ' + given when the entry has a rank (and rankWhen holds), else label, else the raw name. Keys (S.rep, S.phoneBook, contactKey) stay the raw speaker name
ranks.folds: rep.js REP_CANON folds one person's other speaker names into the cast name (Tobin -> Associate Tobin). save.js copies an old key's value to the new key when the new key is absent; the old key stays
ranks.masters: D1437: Hall Masters (Fen, Hale, Marisol) are neutral: faction none, off the Keeper ladder. Master is their Hall title, still shown first (Master Fen).

Commander.note: POST_TRIAL_CRACKDOWN: the Commander stays unnamed (D1198, settled Nov 3: names stay placeholders); rank-only label until Story names him

Officer.note: POST_TRIAL_CRACKDOWN: the escort officers and the curfew posts; rank-only label, like the plaza's (D1245)

ranks.pendingNote: pending: only POST_TRIAL_CRACKDOWN's unnamed Commander and Officer (D1198) are left: rank-only labels until their names are built (NAMES_PASS D1740, D1744). NAMES_PASS (D1738) named the six FERNBROOK_PLAZA rank-only placeholders (D1245); every sworn Keeper on the ladder (KEEPER_RANKS D893) has a rank (D1159); hosts and shopkeepers are civilians (below). rankCheck counts a name listed here as pending, not missing
ranks.civilians: civilian: "host" (Lantern House hosts) or "shop" (anyone who runs a shop counter). Civilians are aligned to a faction (their faction field is unchanged) but are not sworn, so they get no rank and show their name as before (cleared task, Nov 3, 2026; settles the hosts part of D1160)
